senses.gloss: f. (בְּדִי I; cmp. בִּדִּין) fiction, false report, information.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:3:2">Y. Sot. IX, 23ᶜ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 16:3:2">Y. Yeb. XVI, 15ᶜ</cite> <he>ואתצידו כולהון מן ב׳</he> and they were all taken prisoners owing to the information against them. [Rabad Seder hak-Kabb. a. other chroniclers have erroneously <he>ונתלה ר׳ שרירא מידו אחת</he>, read … <he>מן בידה</he> or <cite ref="B00553"><he>בידו</he></cite>.]
